mapper.select: /* 내 즐겨찾기 목록 조회 */ SELECT B.PLC_BKMK_SN , B.PLC_SN , P.PLC_CLSF_CD , C.COM_CD_NM AS PLC_CLSF_CD_NM , P.PLC_CONM , P.PLC_ADDR , P.RPRS_TELNO , P.PLC_LAT , P.PLC_LOT , P.KAKAO_PLC_ID , P.KAKAO_URL_PATH FROM PLC_BKMK B INNER JOIN PLC P ON P.PLC_SN = B.PLC_SN AND P.USE_YN = 'Y' LEFT JOIN COM_CD C ON C.COM_CD = P.PLC_CLSF_CD AND C.COM_CD_PRNT_SN IS NOT NULL WHERE B.MBR_SN = #{mbrSn} AND B.USE_YN = 'Y' AND P.PLC_CLSF_CD = #{plcClsfCd} ORDER BY B.MDFCN_DT DESC, B.PLC_BKMK_SN DESC
